P.value: 1. Revise only ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md and ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/send-to-gemini.js as the requested canonical contract and source-code surfaces. 2. In Agents.md add a Governing Rule Catalog entry named live_ground_truth_verification_against_pathological_deception that incorporates the skill invariants: agent/self-reported evidence is unverified testimony; live authoritative sources are required; memory and prior assistant claims are not ground truth; authority/freshness/execution-proximity/specificity/integrity must be evaluated; conflicts yield UNKNOWN/PARTIAL unless resolved; execution assertions use VERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/NOT EXECUTED. Include definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass/fail criteria, and rule-following/rule-breaking scenarios. 3. Add explicit live-ground-truth evaluation requirements to Step 0, Step 2, Step 3, and Step 4 and extend their supervisory gate contracts so a gate cannot PASS an execution-dependent assertion without the runtime's independent ground-truth findings. Do not add external evaluator-definition read requirements. 4. In send-to-gemini.js add deterministic ground-truth collection that operates from the GitHub Actions workspace and current run container, using actual filesystem metadata/content and git commands for repository/ref/commit claims, plus exact run state/messages/store records. Restrict paths to the repository workspace and capture explicit VERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/NOT_EXECUTED findings with source, locator, observed_content, authority, freshness, specificity, and errors. 5. Derive candidate claims from execution-return evidence-bearing structures, especially source/locator/observed_content fields, completed_actions.completion_evidence, failed/not_completed evidence, role_verification evidence, and execution-dependent strings that identify repository paths, blobs, commits, run records, or workflow artifacts; do not treat the candidate's own assertion as verification. 6. Feed deterministic findings into validationMessage/systemText/supervise before Gemini evaluation, explicitly instruct Gemini that self-asserted evidence is testimony until correlated with those findings, and include the findings in the supervisory prompt. 7. Extend gateTemplate with a required ground_truth_verification section and ground_truth_verification_eval decision records; extend evalValid so PASS is mechanically invalid unless this section is structurally complete and every material execution-dependent claim is VERIFIED or appropriately classified without contradiction being ignored. 8. Persist the deterministic ground-truth findings in each attempt record and supervisor store record so later execution claims can be checked against verbatim historical evidence. 9. Preserve existing transition semantics supervisory_gate.gate_result PASS/FAIL, same-step retry on FAIL, role separation, run isolation, Step3_TSR behavior, and Agents.md as the canonical evaluation source. 10. Commit the two revised files together, read them back from main, and submit Step 4 evidence using the exact commit and committed contents.
